newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via 4-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via 4-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add reserves to the banking system via a round of four-day system repurchase agreements (RPs) Thursday, economists said.

"We estimate that the Fed faces a remaining daily add need around $9.0 billion in the last week of the current maintenance period. Looking ahead, daily add needs of around $10.0 billion will likely persist through mid-May," said economists at UBS Securities Inc. "The sizable reserve needs will likely prompt the Fed to perform another round of outright purchases of coupon securities in the imminent to near future."
Fed funds were trading at 5.56 percent, slightly above the Fed's current official target level of 5.50 percent.
